## Objective

First-release formats become searchable passages.

## Scope

As stated in the objective and acceptance criteria; nothing beyond them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each passage has a stable locator into its original
- [ ] extractor name and version are recorded
- [ ] Arabic and mixed text survive unchanged
- [ ] A source that yields little or no text is flagged, not silently indexed
- [ ] input size and parsing time are bounded

## Test requirements

Fixture tests in Arabic and English.
